title: Pricing a Party of Children and Sharing Adults Whose Discounts Have Not Yet Been Priced
content:
Where children travel in a party on one of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products, and the discounts they attract have not yet been priced onto the package ledger, the priced package value the desk works from is the package price less those discounts. An adult sharing a room or cabin beyond the second in it is a third adult sharing: the third adults sharing on a package are the adults travelling beyond twice the rooms or cabins the package holds, and never fewer than none.

## The two bases

**Children travelling, and fewer rooms or cabins than adults.** Where the package carries children travelling with the party, holds fewer rooms or cabins than it has adults travelling, and its ledger carries no line priced as a child discount and none priced as a third-adult discount — 0 of each — the priced package value is the package price less the product's child discount on a traveller's share for every child travelling and less the product's third-adult discount on a traveller's share for every third adult sharing.

**Children travelling, and rooms or cabins enough for the adults.** Where the package carries children travelling with the party, holds at least as many rooms or cabins as it has adults travelling, and its ledger carries no line priced as a child discount — 0 of them — the priced package value is the package price less the product's child discount on a traveller's share for every child travelling.

**Otherwise.** Where the package carries no child travelling with the party, or a line priced as a child discount already stands on its ledger, or it holds fewer rooms or cabins than it has adults travelling and a line priced as a third-adult discount already stands on its ledger, the priced package value is not reduced under this note.

## Every combination of the conditions

| Children travelling | Rooms or cabins against adults travelling | Lines already priced as a discount on the ledger | The reduction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 or more | fewer rooms or cabins than adults | no child discount line and no third-adult discount line | the child discount for every child, and the third-adult discount for every third adult sharing |
| 1 or more | fewer rooms or cabins than adults | a child discount line, a third-adult discount line, or both | none under this note |
| 1 or more | rooms or cabins at least as many as adults | no child discount line | the child discount for every child |
| 1 or more | rooms or cabins at least as many as adults | a child discount line | none under this note |
| none | either | either | none under this note |

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package priced at 8,000.00 USD recording 3 adults, 1 child and 1 room, on a product whose child discount is 20 per cent and whose third-adult discount is 12 per cent: the travellers travelling are 4, so a traveller's share is 2,000.00 USD. The rooms held, 1, are fewer than the 3 adults, and the third adults sharing are the adults beyond twice the rooms held, being 1. With neither discount line yet on the ledger, the priced package value is 8,000.00 USD less 400.00 USD for the child and less 240.00 USD for the third adult sharing: 7,360.00 USD.

The same package holding 3 rooms has rooms at least as many as its adults, and its priced package value is 8,000.00 USD less 400.00 USD: 7,600.00 USD.

The same package holding 1 room, its ledger already carrying a line priced as a third-adult discount but none priced as a child discount: the priced package value is 8,000.00 USD, not reduced under this note.
